milestones.description: Enough L0 catastrophic spikes for stable eval
L2 relative-stress label positives for model dev gates
logistic_v2 L2 AUROC >= v1 L0 AUROC on replay
Boosting L2 passes precision@10 lift gate vs base rate
Rolling 60d elevated/high tier L2 realized rate

model_comparison.recommendation: Use v2 calibrated L2 for alert tiers; keep v1 L0 p_spike_5d as legacy headline.

findings_summary.best_estimate_borrow: Combine (1) current borrow level, (2) v2 calibrated L2 stress score for spike risk, and (3) delta_borrow_5d_p50 OLS forecast for directional drift. Level/momentum features explain ~5% of forward borrow change; spike L0 remains too rare for calibrated probabilities.
findings_summary.spike_headline: L0 catastrophic spikes: 1 in 69217 replay rows — use rank/decile, not raw P≥30%.
findings_summary.stress_headline: L2 relative stress: 1827 events — v2+calibration for watch/elevated/high tiers.
findings_summary.forecast_headline: Positive delta_borrow_5d_p50 means expected increase in annual borrow fee over the next 5 IBKR/git observations. Low R² (~5%) — use as directional stress, not point forecast.
findings_summary.model_choice: Use v2 calibrated L2 for alert tiers; keep v1 L0 p_spike_5d as legacy headline.
